td_rms.engineering_meaning: Proportional to mechanical energy dissipated by the vibrating structure
td_rms.units: Signal amplitude units (typically acceleration in g or velocity in in/s)
td_rms.input_signal: Raw vibration waveform, 20,480 samples at 20 kHz
td_rms.expected_behaviour: Flat during health; gradual rise during degradation; accelerating rise near failure

td_kurtosis.engineering_meaning: Measures presence of high-amplitude, short-duration impact events
td_kurtosis.input_signal: Raw vibration waveform, 20,480 samples at 20 kHz
td_kurtosis.expected_behaviour: ≈3 in health; rises during degradation; may decline near failure (documented non-monotonic behavior)
td_kurtosis.notes: Non-monotonic near failure is expected physical behavior, not a computation error

td_crest_factor.engineering_meaning: How 'spiky' the waveform is relative to average energy
td_crest_factor.input_signal: Raw vibration waveform, 20,480 samples at 20 kHz
td_crest_factor.expected_behaviour: Low in health; rises ahead of RMS during degradation; may fall as RMS denominator grows faster
